query:
SELECT 'lancamento_custo' as fonte, SUM(valor) as total FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lancamento_salario' as fonte, SUM(valor) as total FROM lancamento_salario WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL' as fonte, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(valor),0) FROM lancamento_salario WHERE periodoCustoId = 60001) as total
